# AMX-30B (`amx30`) — first-party procedural certification

**Status (2026-08-12): GRADUATED.** The playable is generated by
`buildAMX30B` in `src/vehicles/profiles/misc.js` from repository-authored
primitives, fittings, and linked-track code. The Ahab GLB is a local visual
and measurement comparison only; none of its meshes, vertices, textures,
materials, rig, or animation is used at runtime or shipped as playable
geometry.

The rebuild preserves the 6.59 m low hull, five large road-wheel cadence,
compact cast turret, 105 mm gun plus visible 20 mm coax, PH-8-B searchlight,
commander/optic/MG station, smoke banks, supported bustle rack, and layered
rear-service grammar. The raised short sponson course exposes the wheels while
remaining outside the native linked-shoe corridor.
